description: Starts the simulator, optionally presses buttons and types into the Serial Monitor, and samples LED brightness, servo angles and simulator time at the given moments (milliseconds after start). Returns the samples and the end of the Serial Monitor text. The simulator usually runs a bit slower than real time, so leave some margin and check sim_time.

wait_for_serial.description: start the timeline only after this text is printed (e.g. READY)

name: tinkercad_simulate
title: Run the simulation
